mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CrossTeamIsolation allows the model to construct a world where a caller from team T successfully reads or acts on a task in team U (U ≠ T), violating the absolute byte-equivalent 404 guarantee of FR-014. The injection forces an outsider to get ResultSuccess.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamIsolationViolation { some op : Operation | some t : Task | op.opTask = t and op.opCaller.userTeam != t.taskTeam and op.opResult = ResultSuccess }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows the model to place two AuditEntry atoms with the same (entryTask, entryActor, entryOp, entryTeam), which represents an in-place update or duplicate creation of an audit record. The injection forces exactly this collision.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2 : AuditEntry | ae1.entryTask = ae2.entryTask and ae1.entryActor = ae2.entryActor and ae1.entryOp = ae2.entryOp and ae1.entryTeam = ae2.entryTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OwnerOnlyShareControl allows a non-owner (sharee or team admin) to execute PatchSharedWith with ResultSuccess, violating the owner-only invariant mandated by FR-010 / Q1=A. The injection places a successful PatchSharedWith for a non-owner caller.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerOnlyShareViolation { some op : Operation | some t : Task | op.opTask = t and op.opKind = PatchSharedWith and op.opResult = ResultSuccess and t.taskOwner != op.opCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_ShareeCannotDelete lets the model construct a world where a sharee (who is not owner or team admin) successfully deletes a task, violating FR-011 / Q3=B which restricts deletion to owner or team admin only. The injection forces a sharee's delete to succeed.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ShareeDeleteViolation { some op : Operation, ts : TaskShare | op.opKind = DeleteTask and op.opResult = ResultSuccess and op.opTask = ts.shareTask and op.opCaller = ts.sharee and op.opCaller != ts.shareTask.taskOwner and op.opCaller.userRole = Member }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_ShareeSameTeam permits a TaskShare to link a task to a sharee in a different team, violating FR-012's cross-team sharing prohibition. The injection forces a TaskShare where the sharee is in a different team than the task.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamShareViolation { some ts : TaskShare | ts.sharee.userTeam != ts.shareTask.taskTeam }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditActorRoleSnapshot allows an audit entry to record a role that does not match the actor's actual role (e.g., recording 'team_admin' for a member's action), violating the snapshot attribution requirement of FR-016. The injection forces a mismatch between entryActorRole and the actor's actual role.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ActorRoleMismatch { some ae : AuditEntry | ae.entryActorRole != ae.entryActor.userRole }
